industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: ENEFI Vagyonkezelo Nyilvanosan Mukodo Reszvenytarsasag
summary: ENEFI Vagyonkezelo Nyilvánosan Mukodo Részvénytársaság operates as an alternative energy company. The company provides heat supply services, district heating supply services, public lighting systems, and renewable technologies. The company was formerly known as ENEFI Energiahatékonysági Nyrt. ENEFI Vagyonkezelo Nyilvánosan Mukodo Részvénytársaság was founded in 2000 and is based in Budapest, Hungary.
